items.title: Kyiv new-build apartment sales reportedly fall tenfold from 2021
items.summary: Ukrainian media, citing Kyiv School of Development founder Igor Raikov, report that monthly sales of newly built apartments have fallen to around $20 million, compared with $200 million in September 2021. Power outages, Russian strikes, currency fluctuations and limited access to housing programmes were cited as contributing factors.

items.title: Russian envoy emphasizes continued dialogue with Washington
items.summary: Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev stressed the importance of maintaining dialogue with the United States and described American negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner as committed to seeking a peaceful resolution.

items.title: Lviv reportedly nears completion of new crematorium amid burial space shortages
items.summary: Reports indicate that testing is underway at Lviv's new crematorium as construction approaches completion. The city has also been seeking additional burial space amid pressure on existing cemeteries.
